initialExam.title: Bank of Baroda PO 2026
initialExam.description: Bank of Baroda Probationary Officer recruitment through its own or IBPS-based selection process for management trainee positions across India.
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Probationary Officer/Management Trainee in Bank of Baroda
initialExam.careerGrowth: PO → Officer → Manager → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM → ED → CMD.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bankofbaroda.in 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
